errors.text: The targeted property is misidentified as stacking-fault energy rather than coercivity.
The response substitutes single-phase Cantor-type alloys and an fcc–hcp calculation for the dual-phase fcc/C14 FeCoNiTi system.
It conflates longitudinal spin fluctuations and spin moments with the orbital-moment contribution asked about.

It omits the central challenge of explaining how a small fcc orbital moment, through interaction with the C14 phase, spin canting, and domain-wall pinning, produces coercivity well above the approximately 100 Oe single-phase limit.
The predicted SFE and deformation outcomes do not correspond to the reported high coercivity of approximately 667 Oe at 400 K.
